meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可把三类任务交给 cavecrew 子代理:investigator 定位代码位置、builder 修改 1-2 个文件、reviewer 审查 diff。它们返回压缩后的结构化结果,主上下文占用更少。
howto.when: 当你需要查找代码位置、做小范围(≤2 文件)修改,或审查 diff、分支、文件时,Claude 会改派对应的 cavecrew 子代理,而非在主线程处理或使用 Explore。

say.text: 用 cavecrew-investigator 找 X 在哪定义
say.note: 返回 path:line 列表,省上下文

say.text: 用 cavecrew-builder 改这个文件
say.note: 只改已定位的一处,返回改动摘要

say.text: 用 cavecrew-reviewer 审一下这个 diff

howto.what_en: cavecrew gives Claude three subagents: investigator locates code, builder edits 1-2 files, reviewer audits a diff. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.
howto.when_en: Used when you want to locate code, make a small (≤2 file) edit, or review a diff — Claude delegates to the matching cavecrew subagent instead of working inline or using Explore.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-investigator to find where X is defined
Use cavecrew-builder to make this small edit
say_en.note: Edits one known site, returns a change summary
Lists findings by file and line
